verdict.rationale: Qapita is an equity-management SaaS platform, so user-configurable background automations are a fair question. However, the evidence only describes built-in 'automated' reporting and fund-administration features. Nothing shows users can define their own automations, triggers, or schedules that run autonomously. Those generic automation claims are adjacent product features, not the capability this story asks about.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
